_about: An AI-generated first draft of Void Trader's text. Some lines will be wrong or clumsy: corrections are very welcome on GitHub (Syncriel/void-trader, translations/). Lines left as "" stay in English. Keep {1}, {2} ... in order. Button names (CROSS, CIRCLE, D-PAD...) are kept in English, as in the Pilot's Handbook.
